source_document.body:
EcoFlow is once again leading our Green Deals with the launch of its DELTA 3000 Gen4 and DELTA 3800 Gen4 Power Stations and bundles at up to $1,435 off, not to mention the brand has launched another 48-hour flash sale with options like the DELTA 2 Max 2,048Wh Power Station, 2x 220W solar panels , a free bag, and a free TRAIL 200 DC station at $1,529 + others from $659. We also have three Black Friday deals from Segway, like the Myon Smart Electric Bike down at $1,600 , and Lectric’s official full Black Friday e-bike sale with up to $822 in savings (including price cuts). At the very bottom of the page, you’ll also find all the deals and sales from across this week collected together.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
EcoFlow DELTA Gen4 Series power stations and bundles launch with up to $1,435 savings from $1,214
Alongside EcoFlow’s early Black Friday deals , as well as the TITAN Whole-Home Backup Ecosystem launch , the brand has also just launched its latest DELTA 3000 Gen4 3,072Wh Portable Power Station with extra savings down at $1,214.05 shipped , after using the code DG4EDM at checkout, as well as the larger DELTA 3800 Gen4 3,763Wh model down at $1,614.05 shipped , using the same code – plus, the first 500 orders on both models get a FREE trolley. These new models will run for $1,699 and $2,199 at full price once these launch deals end, with the code giving you a combined $485 and $585 markdowns right out of the gate. Head below to browse their various bundle options.
***Note: We have not factored in the extra savings code into the prices you see below, so be sure to use DG4EDM at checkout for the best launch prices during this period.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
EcoFlow’s DELTA 3000 Gen4 launch deal options:
DELTA 3000 Gen4 (3,072Wh) power station: $1,299 (Reg. $1,699)
DELTA 3000 Gen4 (3,072Wh) with 2x 160W solar panels: $1,799 (Reg. $2,299)
EcoFlow’s DELTA 3800 Gen4 launch deal options:
DELTA 3800 Gen4 (3,763Wh) power station: $1,699 (Reg. $2,199)
DELTA 3800 Gen4 (3,763Wh) with 2x 160W solar panels: $2,199 (Reg. $2,899)
DELTA 3800 Gen4 (6kWh) with DELTA 3 Max Plus battery: $2,299 (Reg. $2,999)
DELTA 3800 Gen4 (3,763Wh) with 4x 160W solar panels: $2,599 (Reg. $3,299)
DELTA 3800 Gen4 (6kWh) with battery and 2x 160W solar panels: $2,699 (Reg. $3,999)
You can learn all about these new Gen4 power stations’ features in our launch coverage here .
Score up to $1,100 early Black Friday savings on three Segway EVs: Myon smart e-bike hits $1,600 ($400 off), more from $650
While Segway hasn’t launched a full Black Friday lineup yet, we are seeing some early event savings hitting three EVs currently, with one being the Myon Smart Electric Bike down at $1,599.99 shipped . Down from $2,000, this 2026 model hit the scene at the top of the year from CES 2026, with it not getting its first discount until July, when it fell to $1,550 for only a few days before rising up to $1,800, which is the consistent discounted rate we’ve been seeing since. Now, these early Black Friday deals are giving you $400 savings to land just $50 above that one-time low, making it the best price we’ve spotted in four months. You can also find the Xafari All-Terrain Fat Tire Cruiser e-bike down at a new $1,300 low , as well as the F3 Electric Scooter down at its $650 2026 low . What’s more, for the e-bikes, buying two of them gives you an additional $200 savings off your cart’s total.
Lectric Black Friday Sale offers up to $822 bundle and price cut savings on e-bikes starting from $899
Alongside the launches of its Limited-Edition XP4 750 e-bikes (with up to $840 savings) and the XP Lite3 e-bike , Lectric has officially kicked off its full Black Friday Sale event for the month with up to $822 in savings to score. One extremely large bundle package and price cut is hitting the XPeak2 Long-Range Off-Road e-bikes with $647 FREE bundles of gear at $1,599 shipped , not to mention some notable savings on its standard models (more on those below). Normally these longer-distance packages would run you $2,346 without the bundle savings and the $100 price cut, with this being the largest offer we have seen on them this year. The bundle includes a rear cargo rack, fender set, Elite headlight, suspension seat post, bike lock, phone mount, a water-resistant pannier bag, and a 5A charger that cuts charging time down to four hours.
You can check out the full Lectric Black Friday lineup of deals right here .
EcoFlow 48-hour flash sale offers DELTA 2 Max 440W solar bundle + FREE bag and TRAIL 200 DC station at $1,529, more
EcoFlow is quite busy right now between the launch deals on its TITAN Whole-Home Backup Ecosystem and the DELTA Gen4 Series , not to mention the early Black Friday Sale that now has a 48-hour flash period with deals on four units. Among the options, there’s a nice bundle opportunity to score the 2,048Wh DELTA 2 Max Power Station with 2x 220W solar panels , a FREE protective bag ($79 value) – plus, you also get a FREE 192Wh TRAIL 200 DC power station ($119 value) – all at $1,529 shipped . This beats out the deal for the station, panels, and TRAIL unit at Amazon by $50 . The station and solar panels alone go for $1,579 at full price, and while we saw the cost go lower earlier in the year, it’s mostly kept at this rate (or as high as $1,599 at Amazon) since August, with October’s Prime Day dropping it to $1,499 for a short period. The deal here gives you $50 off the typical bundle’s going rate, but provides $198 in additional savings ($248 total) with the two FREE items added.
***Note: Keep in mind that certain cart total thresholds give you additional FREE gear: purchases of $600 or more give you a free RIVER 2 waterproof bag, purchases of $1,500 or more gives you a free TRAIL 200 DC station, and purchases over $2,500 gives you 2x free 100W rigid solar panels.

Smart Duel Fuel Generator 3000: $659 (Reg. $749) | not available at Amazon
DELTA 2 Max (2,048Wh) with 2x 220W solar panels: $1,529 (Reg. $1,579) | $50 more at Amazon without bag comes with FREE bag ($79 value)
2x DELTA 3 Ultra (3,072Wh each) power stations: $2,398 (Reg. $3,198) | $200 more at Amazon
2x DELTA Pro Ultra Series extra batteries (6,144Wh each): $4,399 (Reg. $6,599) | $2,199 more at Amazon

Segway Xafari All-Terrain Electric Bike: $1,300 (Reg. $2,400)
Lectric XP4 750 LR Folding Utility e-bikes w/ $532 bundle: $1,299 (Reg. $1,831)
XPeak2 Standard Step-Thru Off-Road e-bike with $400 bundle: $1,299 (Reg. $1,899)
Heybike Hybrid Longest Range Commuter e-bike (use code 9T5T500 ): $1,199 (Reg. $1,699)
Heybike ALPHA Mid-Drive All-Terrain e-bike (use code 9TO5TOYS200 ): $1,099 (Reg. $1,799)

Yozma IN 10 Electric Mini Dirt Bike (use code ELECTREK ): $949 (Reg. $1,599)
Segway F3 Electric Scooter: $650 (Reg. $1,000)
Best new Green Deals landing this week
The savings this week are also continuing to a collection of other markdowns. To the same tune as the offers above, these all help you take a more energy-conscious approach to your routine. Winter means you can lock in even better off-season price cuts on electric tools for the lawn while saving on EVs and tons of other gear.
Rare MOD Bikes savings land ahead of Black Friday – Easy 3 cruiser $200 off, more from $1,799
With leaves finally falling, this 13A Worx electric mulcher is ready for the yard work at $125 (Up to $65 off)
Anker’s Apple Home-ready solar security cam bundles fall as low as $360, no sub required
